preconditions.description: The number of test cases T must be between 1 and 10,000.
The dimensions N and M of the grid must be between 2 and 1,000.

preconditions.expression: len(B) == N * M and all(1 <= B[i] <= 10**9 for i in range(len(B)))
preconditions.description: The array B must contain exactly N * M distinct elements, each between 1 and 1,000,000,000.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '\n'.join(' '.join(map(str, row)) for row in A)
postconditions.description: The output must be the grid A formatted as N lines of M space-separated integers.
The score of the grid, defined as the difference between the largest and smallest elements visited, must be minimized.
